# Parker McGovern — Mortgage Agent (Level 2)

> Licensed Ontario mortgage agent based in Richmond Hill, serving the Greater
> Toronto Area. Independent of any single lender: one application is placed
> with a panel of banks, credit unions and monoline lenders.

Licensing: FSRA Mortgage Agent Level 2, Licence M21002541, registered with
Mortgagebroker.ca, Brokerage Licence 12707. Rates, payments and qualification
figures published on this site are estimates, not commitments to lend, and are
subject to lender approval.
